summary: This trailer introduces a multi-hour educational series that promises a complete teardown and rebuild of a Mazda MX-5 Miata, explained piece by piece with a focus on on-car demonstrations and high-fidelity 3D graphics. The host outlines a learning approach that emphasizes understanding how each component functions in situ, alongside plans for interactive 3D models accessible on web and mobile, with eventual virtual reality integration. The video highlights key systems and parts to be covered (engine, transmission, ABS, MAF, radiator cap), the use of specific tools, and a hands-on philosophy that includes dealing with real-world issues like rust and seized bolts. A pre-order drive is presented to fund production and earn participant recognition in credits.
title: How a Car Works Trailer — On-Car 3D Visualization and MX-5 Miata Deep Dive
